name: Rhen
source: Rhen, the mysterious wolf-eared rogue, seems to know more about this game and the virus than anyone else. Though he seems calm and prepared to face any issues that arise, he harbors a troubled past that makes him closed off from others. The more you get to know him, the more you wonder just who he is in real life and the true connection you both share. Will you keep him safe and learn the truth behind the virus, or will he be infected before you get the chance?
